stops.name: Bettmeralp
stops.quote: The ski pistes at the two car-free villages of Bettmeralp and Riederalp afford unobstructed views of the highest mountains in Switzerland.
stops.english: The ski pistes at the two car-free villages of Bettmeralp and Riederalp afford unobstructed views of the highest mountains in Switzerland.

stops.name: Riederalp
stops.quote: From there the run follows a blue-marked trail back to the Riederalp.
stops.english: From there the run follows a blue-marked trail back to the Riederalp.

stops.name: Bettmerhorn
stops.quote: This intermediate run begins with magnificent views near the cable car top station at the Bettmerhorn.
stops.english: This intermediate run begins with magnificent views near the cable car top station at the Bettmerhorn.

stops.name: Aletsch Piste
stops.quote: The Aletsch Piste guarantees fun on the snow with direct views of Switzerland’s highest mountains – on the opposite side of the Rhone Valley you will see the magnificent four-thousand-metre-high Valais peaks against the deep blue sky.
stops.english: The Aletsch Piste guarantees fun on the snow with direct views of Switzerland’s highest mountains – on the opposite side of the Rhone Valley you will see the magnificent four-thousand-metre-high Valais peaks against the deep blue sky.

stops.name: Blausee chairlift
stops.quote: The red-marked trail on the sunny southern slope takes you westwards to the route followed by the Blausee chairlift.
stops.english: The red-marked trail on the sunny southern slope takes you westwards to the route followed by the Blausee chairlift.
